records.text: Local sheriff's departments, the SWAT team, and other firsthand sources believed federal agents set Tyler Robinson up and misdirected local investigators about the gun.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #4 (Ep 7ERqbYElOfs)

appearances.snippet: OK, everyone in the town, all the local sheriff departments, the SWAT team, they believe that the feds came in and they started lying and they were sending people on wild goose chase and they said the gun was here and they said it was over there. There was no gun. They didn't want the bomb dogs to go into certain places. Like I said, I am not getting this information from people that do not have the credibility to assert that. That's how I got. The pictures inside of the car. Okay, I'm speaking to people with firsthand intimate knowledge, and they all believe that the feds set this up.

verification.notes: The allegation relies on unnamed local and firsthand sources. Official records and current hearing coverage document recovery and testing of the rifle but do not corroborate claims that federal agents misdirected local investigators or that local agencies believed Robinson was framed.
